question: Which type of rubber Ebonite is?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3) i.e **__Highly vulcanized rubber.__**

__
 
• **Ebonite** is a type of Hard rubber.
 
• It is invented by **Good year company.**
 
• It is obtained by vulcanizing natural rubber for prolonged periods.
 
• It has **25-30% sulphur.**

***Notes:*__**

 
• **Vulcanisation:**

 
 
• It is the process of **improving rubber strength.**
 
• **Charles Goodyear **invented this process.
 
• It is done by** heating rubber with sulphur.**
 
• There is cross-linking of the chain of rubber molecules with sulphur atoms in between.
